title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
abstract: arXiv:2609.35944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous

translated_title: EnJoi：用于生成式数据同化的集成联合分数滤波器
translated_abstract: 数据同化旨在恢复仅被部分观测的动力学系统的完整状态。一种解决方案是使用基于分数的模型来生成与观测相符且物理上合理的轨迹。这些自回归扩散模型通过以先前状态为条件进行训练；然而，它们并未考虑过去预测的不确定性。我们提出了一种新的基于扩散的同化算法，该算法能够动态平衡对当前状态的置信度和对新观测的置信度。至关重要的是，我们选择学习包含过去和未来的联合状态的分布。这使我们能够使用En4DVar的改进版本，En4DVar是一种依赖于粒子集合协方差的经典数据同化算法。在流体和交通流模拟上的实验表明，重建性能得到提升，尤其是在观测稀疏且非均匀的情况下。
tldr: 该论文提出EnJoi，一种基于扩散模型的生成式数据同化方法，通过学习过去与未来状态的联合分布并结合改进的En4DVar集成算法，动态平衡当前状态与观测之间的置信度，从而在稀疏、非均匀观测条件下显著提升状态重建性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EnJoi, a diffusion-based generative data assimilation method that learns the joint distribution of past and future states and leverages a modified En4DVar ensemble algorithm to dynamically balance confidence between the current state and observations, achieving improved state reconstruction especially under sparse and non-homogeneous observations.
